nodes.name: Lemma 2.3: LF splitting property holds for $\Omega_1$
nodes.statement: Assume that $\mathbf{U} = (\rho,y,z)^\top \in \Omega_1$, then the LF splitting form $\widehat{\mathbf{U}}_\pm := \mathcal{S}^\pm_{\tt LF}(\mathbf{U}) = \mathbf{U} \pm \alpha^{-1} \mathbf{F} (\mathbf{U}) \in \Omega_1$ provided that $\alpha > v(\mathbf{U}) > 0$.

nodes.name: Lemma 2.4: GQL linear equivalence of $\Omega_2$
Theorem 2.6: generalized LF splitting property holds for $\Omega$
nodes.statement:
If 
	$\widehat{\mathbf{U}}=(\hat{\rho},\hat{y},\hat{z})^\top \in \Omega$ and 
	$\widecheck{\mathbf{U}}=(\check{\rho},\check{y},\check{z})^\top \in \Omega$, then 
	$\mathrlap{ \raisebox{0.6 pt}{$\widecheck{\phantom{\mathbf{U}}}$} } \mathrlap{ \raisebox{-0.6 pt}{$\widehat{\phantom{\mathbf{U}}}$} } \mathbf{U} = (\mathrlap{ \raisebox{0.5 pt}{$\check{\phantom{\rho}}$} } \mathrlap{ \raisebox{-0.5 pt}{$\hat{\phantom{\rho}}$} } \rho,\mathrlap{ \raisebox{0.5 pt}{$\check{\phantom{y}}$} } \mathrlap{ \raisebox{-0.5 pt}{$\hat{\phantom{y}}$} } y,\mathrlap{ \raisebox{0.5 pt}{$\check{\phantom{z}}$} } \mathrlap{ \raisebox{-0.5 pt}{$\hat{\phantom{z}}$} } z)^\top$ $:= \mathcal{S}_{\tt GLF}(\widehat{\mathbf{U}},\widecheck{\mathbf{U}})\in \Omega$,
	under the condition $\alpha > \alpha_{\max}(\widehat{\mathbf{U}},\widecheck{\mathbf{U}})$.

Lemma 4.5: BP property of forward-Euler steps
Theorem 4.6: the proposed scheme is BP w r t global invariant domain
Theorem 4.7: the proposed scheme is BP w r t local invariant domain
nodes.statement:
If the local invariant domains $\Omega^{n,s}_j$ defined in (4.7) are considered, then the scheme (4.1) with $\alpha \ge \max_j \alpha_{\max}(\mathbf{U}^-_{j+\frac12},\mathbf{U}^+_{j+\frac12})$ and under the CFL condition (4.14) is locally BP, namely,
	\begin{equation}
		\mathbf{U}^n_j(x^{\tt GL}_{j,\ell}) \in \Omega^{n}_j
		~~ \forall j ~ \forall \ell
		~~ \Longrightarrow ~~
		\mathbf{U}^{n+1}_j(x^{\tt GL}_{j,\ell}) \in \Omega^{n+1}_j
		~~ \forall j ~ \forall \ell.
	\end{equation}
